Hadith.5748 - Ali ibn Al-Hakam narrated from Aban Al-Ahmar from Muyassir from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"I asked Imam (as) about women and what share they have in inheritance.
Imam (as) said: 'They have the value of bricks, buildings, wood, and reeds, but as for land and properties, they have no inheritance in them.'
I said: 'What about clothing?'
Imam (as) said: 'Clothing is for them.'
I said: 'How is this, while they have a specified share of one-eighth or one-fourth?'
Imam (as) said: 'Because a woman has no lineage through which she inherits; she is merely an addition to them. This ruling exists so that a woman does not marry, and then her husband or the children of another people come and compete with others in their properties.'"
